author: TehKey
body: Beowulf is good because it doesn't require much gear to do well in most content. Deity does require more gear to do well, so it is typically not as good as Grand Summoner or Beowulf for early t10. If you have Arisen Spiritgarm as a fresh t10 Beo, you'll be able to solo lots of raids, which will skyrocket your level.

author: dreambig5
body:
Personally, I enjoy GS (GSA especially) because it's my easiest one to clear dungeons, & towers with & it's not too bad for raids either. Not sure if you've seen this guide.

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JDNee0miAjx\_pGWp6MxrEq\_e7NnmJsbS11x60brE4sw/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JDNee0miAjx_pGWp6MxrEq_e7NnmJsbS11x60brE4sw/edit?usp=sharing)

\---

Deity only makes sense at lvl 245 or 250 due to Ultima & Ultima 2. I didnt listen to this advice & unlocked the class early. I like BeoA as well.

I think it is better to go with GSA first. Then get yourself enough for a Celestial Axe. Then GSH (Just or the Ancient Dragon summon). Celestial axe with 4 shoulders of prom & 1 sturdy feet of promethus for ward recovery every turn. Try to get as many tower shards as you can while you are T9. Also keep killing as many Mammons as you can until you get a near 100% Ornate Fallen Shield (great for ward & protects against Cursed).

My GSA helped me get enough tower shards to forge 2 of every weapon (T10 ones), all the classes, all the pets, and I'm still sitting on 1 mil towershards most of the time (I occassionaly use it to buy materials, but it's easy to earn it back quite quickly). 

\---

Once you manage to complete lvl 50 tower, you should have plenty of orns for everything else. I'd also suggest learning how to grind endless dungeons (they have some nice rewards as well). 

If your problem is orns, keep doing memory hunts (diluted nmeumonics) until you get 100% bonus for memory hunts amity & enough proofs until you can unlock both pets in the Oracle temple. When you hit t10, get yourself a trialing weapon (Axe, staff or bow from the wvyern hunts event). Pet + Amities + Trialing weapon = easy xp, orns, & gold.
